title: Installments After Guest Mode
h1: Guest-mode buyer on spi-high-aov: no premature address banner, SMS code at underwriting, Affirm agreement fails
subtitle: Frames from the Playwright trace of spec 5, attempt 2, run from Erin's machine against production on 2026-09-30. Bug hunt doc case 4 ("New buyer — Installments") on the store the bug hunt used, USD 350 product. Frames are unedited screencast stills of the main window, or test screenshots taken by the spec where marked.
override: EXP_OVERRIDES e_ac6fae2281b0e908985ecf9c8069ba5d=treatment (header sent for the whole run)

moments.name: pay-checkout-landed
moments.title: A1. Guest mode: straight into Pay checkout
moments.body: Benchmark alias {email} submitted at the Shop Pay sign-in; no phone field and no SMS step. The spec asserts the phone input and the phone verification step have zero matches.

moments.name: empty-form-no-banner
moments.title: A2. Empty shipping form, no Installments banner
moments.body: Pay in installments is listed and enabled while the shipping form holds only region defaults. The spec asserts the text "Installments can only be used to ship to a valid US address" has zero matches. This is the behaviour PR 1021476 (merged 2026-09-23) introduced.

moments.name: address-filled-no-banner
moments.title: A4. US address and phone filled, still no banner
moments.body: 61 W Houston St, New York, with shipping phone 773555xxxx typed into the address form. Banner still absent and the Installments option still enabled.

moments.name: installments-selected
moments.title: A5. Pay in installments selected, card added
moments.body: The card form is filled with a test Shopify Payments card and the primary button changes to continue to payment plans.

moments.name: installments-phone-otp
moments.title: A6. Underwriting asks for an SMS code
moments.body: Clicking continue sends POST /pay/verifications (201) and the Installments modal asks for the code sent to the shipping phone, the phone guest mode skipped in A1. The spec enters the benchmark code.

moments.name: affirm-identity-done
moments.title: A7. Affirm identity verification
moments.body: The Affirm iframe shows "Verify your information" with the A3 address and a date of birth. PATCH /pay/session and POST /pay/installments/opt_in both return 200 (opt_in: success, eligibility true, income verification provided).

moments.name: installments-unavailable
moments.title: A7. Agreement fails: "We're experiencing technical issues"
moments.body: POST /pay/transactions/{{checkout_token}}/agreements returns 422 with body {{"errors":[{{"error":"checkout_error"}}],"error_classification":{{"error_type":"unknown","retry_eligible":false,"failure_stage":"api_response"}}}}. The iframe replaces the plan step with "Installments aren't available at this time. Try again later, or pay in full to complete your purchase." and a Return to checkout button. No payment plan is offered and the order is not placed.

moments.name: run-end
moments.title: End of run
moments.body: The spec stops here by design: it waits for either the Affirm Complete purchase button or the technical-issues text and fails by name with the recorded agreement response. Attempt 1 (14:23Z) reached the same 422 on checkout token b0d14f3ae08c59177372f92114210a1c, so this is reproducible on this store today.

proves: On spi-high-aov, a guest-mode buyer sees no Installments address banner on an empty shipping form, nor after entering a valid US address. The 2026-09-23 fix (PR 1021476) holds under guest mode.
Installments underwriting asks for an SMS code to the shipping phone, so the phone verification guest mode skips is recovered before any payment plan is offered.

After identity verification, the Affirm agreement request fails with 422 checkout_error on both attempts today (14:23Z and 14:39Z), and the buyer is told to pay in full. Case 4's expected outcome, "the order completes", was not reached.
caveats: The 422 body is shop-server's generic wrapper for a non-2xx from the upstream agreements API (engines/pay/app/services/pay/installments/agreements_api.rb, handle_response). The trace has no upstream detail; the server logs an agreements_call debug event with the upstream HTTP status.

Separated the same day: John's tracked guest-mode spec on spi-e2e-testing (USD 65) passed at 15:14Z with the agreement returning 202; spec 5 with the USD 100 product on spi-high-aov failed with the same 422 at 15:17Z; and a control spec on spi-high-aov with guest mode forced to control and an ordinary email, phone and SMS-code sign-up failed with the same 422 at 15:21Z. The failure follows the store, not guest mode or the amount.
The bug hunt doc records case 4 as passed by John and Nabeel. Their runs were manual and may not have used the benchmark identity.
Full run {duration} s. Store is not on the e2e pod, so this spec stays local. Benchmark identity: simulated SMS; one browser, one run per attempt.
